scope: Exact administrative launch clearance only; parent owns authorization and execution. This review does not pass the source-publication gate or authorize scientific execution.
method: Read-only source inspection, file-size checks and SHA256 checks. No helper, supervisor, network acquisition, model, control, audit, archive decoding, UI or Git mutation was executed by this reviewer.

clearedLaunch.python: Unoptimized Python; both programs explicitly reject optimization.
clearedLaunch.allocation: One prospective administrative allocation, at most one exact-OID fetch per listed blob and three fetches total; first command, identity or observed limit failure stops the allocation.

checks: The protocol contains exactly the three remaining descriptors: transport parts003 and004 and the radial-integration audit, with the reviewed lengths, SHA256 values, Git blob OIDs and origin commit.
Each requested object uses a newly created separate bare store, empty initial object inventory and no alternates, reference repository, copied packs or existing body-object reuse.
The only fetch target is the exact configured blob OID over the configured SSH remote. There is no branch, tag, history, clone, retry or fallback path.
Complete post-fetch object inventory must equal the single expected blob with its exact length before streamed length, SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 verification.
Current fixed-source and origin path-to-blob tree bindings are checked and saved. Original repository access is limited to metadata and pinned administrative/source-manifest records.
Authenticated SSH body evidence is distinguished explicitly from anonymous public body reads; earlier acquisition records and their failed-attempt history remain separate.
Helper command starts, completions, tree bindings and stream-hash outcomes are journaled under private temporary storage with flush and fsync.

The helper and its direct tool descendants inherit the outer-created process group. The supervisor sweeps that group on helper completion or failure, reaps the helper and checks group absence before a passed closure.
The supervisor catches unreadable or incomplete helper closure files, retains already captured file pins and emits a failed outer closure instead of treating an invalid receipt as success.
Exact private temporary launch copies remove cloud-backed helper/protocol startup reads from the supervisor path; subsequent repository reads occur within the supervised helper.
The protocol and receipt honestly distinguish the 48 MiB per-file OS limit from monitored 96 MiB/store, 256 MiB aggregate and 2 MiB diagnostic thresholds. Observed excess fails the allocation.
remainingLimitations: Server acceptance of direct blob wants remains unknown. Refusal is a failed attempt and permits no broader fetch.
Static clearance establishes the reviewed procedure only; it does not establish that any fetch, hash, deadline or process-cleanup check has succeeded.
A passed acquisition still requires independent saved-evidence review and a complete 74-pin composite before the source-publication gate or producer launch.
